# Research World
> Capture web evidence with an LLM, freeze a snapshot, compare research-agent observations.

- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)

Development alpha. Native subscription authentication stays in the native client.
Frozen tools do not guarantee whole-process isolation. Citation matching does not
prove correctness. Example comparison reports contain answers: exclude them from
research-agent context when evaluating the corresponding world.
